europe_now.title: France Blames Iran for Supermarket Fridge Cyberattacks
europe_now.summary: French authorities have officially accused Iran's Revolutionary Guards of orchestrating a series of cyberattacks targeting commercial refrigeration units in supermarkets. The investigation, led by the Paris prosecutor, highlights growing security concerns over state-sponsored digital disruptions on vital commercial infrastructure.
